justification: `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/util/StringUtil.java` is a catch-all utility with 28 public static methods and clearly mixed responsibilities: timestamp formatting, XML entity replacement, padding/alignment, text/list conversion, substring and package/class-name extraction, attribute string parsing/serialization, thousands formatting, word wrapping, and key sorting. The corresponding `core/src/test/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/test/TestStringUtil.java` covers only a subset of these behaviors, reinforcing that the class bundles several separable concerns rather than a cohesive abstraction.
